reserveReview.rationale: Observed 2026-09-21: Gold Token SA's live registry reports Base, Ethereum and Solana in matched reconciliation state. Aggregate token supply is 2,411.954999968 DGLD against 2,411.955 fine troy ounces across six live, serial-numbered PAMP bars. Base and Ethereum report zero gaps; Solana reports a 0.000000032 DGLD rounding gap. The registry therefore supports the full 100% allocation to physical PAMP gold at this checkpoint.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gold Token SA live bar registry reconciliation of all issued DGLD across Base, Ethereum and Solana to serial-numbered allocated PAMP bars
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live registry reconciles every network supply to allocated PAMP bar weight. The only reported difference is a 0.000000032 DGLD Solana base-unit rounding gap, below the composition precision and materiality tolerance.
